components.name: Card
components.description: Every section: Slate Card on Night Sky, hairline border, led by an uppercase section label.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; background: var(--card, #151A21); color: var(--foreground, #E6E8EB); border: 1px solid var(--border, #232831); border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9AA3AD); } .ds-card-figure { margin: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-figure span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9AA3AD); }

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: The site's main control: a tray of choices, the selected one raised with the red selection line.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--card, #151A21); border: 1px solid var(--input, #2B313B); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-seg-item { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9AA3AD); font: 500 14px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: var(--foreground, #E6E8EB); } .ds-seg-item[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--secondary, #1A1F27); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary, #E82127); } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(154 163 173 / 0.5); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Top bar page links; the current page raised with the selection line.
components.html: SolarImpactDistributionTrue-Up
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9AA3AD); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foreground, #E6E8EB); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--secondary, #1A1F27); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary, #E82127); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(154 163 173 / 0.5); }

components.name: Save button
components.description: The admin forms' primary action; light, not red, for contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-save { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--foreground, #E6E8EB); color: var(--background, #0E1116); font: 500 14px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-save:hover { background: rgb(230 232 235 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-save:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(154 163 173 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-save:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Secondary admin actions such as loading a statement into the form.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #2B313B); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(43 49 59 / 0.3); color: var(--foreground, #E6E8EB); font: 500 13px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgb(43 49 59 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(154 163 173 / 0.5); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Admin fields, figures typed in mono.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #2B313B); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(43 49 59 / 0.3); color: var(--foreground, #E6E8EB); font: 400 14px 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(154 163 173 / 0.6); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, #9AA3AD); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(154 163 173 / 0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--destructive, #F87171); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(248 113 113 / 0.2); }

components.name: Live status pill
components.description: The top bar's live readings with flow-color swatches, after the live dot.
components.html: Live 2:41 PMSOLAR 4.2 kW · HOME 1.1 kW · POWERWALL 86%
components.css: .ds-live { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; font: 400 13px 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9AA3AD); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-live-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #31B76B; } .ds-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #2B313B); border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--foreground, #E6E8EB); } .ds-pill i { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a panel of readouts for one home's energy system. It sits beside the Tesla app in spirit: the same five flow colors, Tesla red as the single accent, a dark field that lets live figures glow. Every surface is a gauge or a log; nothing is there to sell.

Density is moderate and technical. Figures are set in IBM Plex Mono so digits line up and changing values don't jitter; labels, headings and prose are IBM Plex Sans. Structure comes from hairline borders and two tonal steps above the page, not from decoration. Color is reserved for meaning: a flow's color always names that flow, and red marks the current selection, an outage, or a mark that must be found at once.

There is one theme, dark, because the Distribution house scene is dark and every page matches it. The scene keeps its own styling; this system frames it.
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme; no light mode.
Five fixed flow colors, the Tesla app's, used identically on every page.
Tesla red as a marker, never as a surface or as body text.
Flat bordered cards on a darker page.
Controls stay quiet so the figures lead.

rules.name: The One Flow, One Color Rule
rules.body: A flow's color means that flow and nothing else. Never reuse Solar yellow for a warning or Powerwall green for "success" outside a flow, the live dot excepted.

rules.name: The Red Marker Rule
rules.body: Tesla Red is for marks, indicators and text of 24px or more. Body text, button labels and fills behind text use Moonlight or white instead; that is why Save is light, not red.

rules.name: The Mono Means Measured Rule
rules.body: A number that was measured or computed is set in Plex Mono; words around it are in Plex Sans. A date in running prose stays sans.

rules.name: The Chapter Word Rule
rules.body: Oversized words head the home page's chapters and nothing else. A chapter word takes its chapter's flow color only when the chapter is about that flow (Today and the year in Solar amber, Habits in Home blue); otherwise Moonlight. "Now" is Moonlight, because it is about every flow.

dos: Do use the design tokens (`text-solar`, `bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`), never raw hex in components.
Do color every flow with its own flow color, the same on every page and chart.
Do set measured figures in Plex Mono and everything else in Plex Sans.
Do mark a selection with Raised Slate plus the 2px Tesla Red line at the bottom.
Do build cards as Slate Card with a 1px Hairline border, 10px corners, 16/24px padding and an uppercase section label.
Do keep navigation targets 44px tall and segment choices 40px.
donts: Don't set body text, button labels or small text in Tesla Red; it is below 4.5:1 on the dark field.
Don't reuse a flow color for an unrelated meaning.
Don't restyle the Distribution house scene with this system; it keeps its own styling.
Don't animate layout properties; motion stays on transform, opacity, clip-path and SVG stroke.
